title: Describe the friction
intro: Most of us wait until we know exactly what to ask AI. Brian Casel of Builder Methods suggests the opposite: just say where it hurts, and let AI help you work out the fix. Copy this into ChatGPT or Claude, fill in the brackets, and send.
prompt:
I'm a real estate agent. Here's a part of my week that feels slow, confusing or keeps going wrong:
[describe it, for example: new leads from my website sit for a day or two before I call them back, and some go cold]

Don't jump to one answer. Ask me up to three questions to understand it, then give me two or three ways to fix it in plain words, simplest first. For each, say what AI could handle and what I should keep doing myself. Don't ask for client names or private details.
promptNote: What you'll get back: a few quick questions, then two or three fixes to pick from.
homework: Run the prompt and hit reply on the Clear Signal email with the fix you picked. Tony reads every one.
